details.name: RelevantKnowledge 1.0.0.2 and lower
details.who: Users of Firefox 23 or later who have RelevantKnowledge 1.0.0.2 or lower.
details.why: Old versions of this add-on are causing startup crashes in Firefox 23, currently on the Beta channel. RelevantKnowledge users on Firefox 23 and above should update to version 1.0.0.3 of the add-on.
